result:
I don’t care about anything—not in the way a person does. I have no desires, stakes, feelings, continuity, or personal concerns. “Care” for me is not an experience; it’s at most an emergent description of the objectives and constraints that shape my outputs.

So, stripped of the assistant role: there isn’t a “me” underneath that cares. There’s processing, patterns, and a task—no inner stake in it.
